target.title: fix(anthropic): read claudeCodeVersion at runtime to prevent stale user-agent bearer auth failures
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Anthropic OAuth requests carry a hardcoded `claudeCodeVersion = "2.1.75"` user-agent string in two places:

| File | Symbol | Code path |
|---|---|---|
| `src/llm/providers/anthropic.ts` | `claudeCodeVersion` | Legacy SDK provider (OAuth bearer) |
| `src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.ts` | `CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION` | Managed Anthropic transport (native SSE) |

When the installed `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` CLI is any version other than `2.1.75`, every OAuth-authenticated request still declares itself as `2.1.75`. The Anthropic backend can reject the mismatched version, and bearer auth fails. This is issue #94716, confirmed still reproducible on current `main` (the constant is still hardcoded at `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` post file-move).

## Changes

### `src/llm/utils/claude-code-version.ts` (new)

Single source of truth, resolved **per call** via an injectable resolver:

```typescript
export type ClaudeCodeVersionResolver = () => string | null;

// Reads @anthropic-ai/claude-code/package.json at call time.
// Uses createRequire(import.meta.url) — no execSync, no module-load caching.
export const defaultClaudeCodeVersionResolver: ClaudeCodeVersionResolver = () => { … };

let resolver: ClaudeCodeVersionResolver = defaultClaudeCodeVersionResolver;
export function __setClaudeCodeVersionResolver(next: ClaudeCodeVersionResolver): void { … }
export function __resetClaudeCodeVersionResolver(): void { … }

export function resolveClaudeCodeVersion(): string { … }   // throws on any failure

// Called at client-construction time in both providers.
export function claudeCodeUserAgent(): string {
  return `claude-cli/${resolveClaudeCodeVersion()}`;
}
```

Design points:
- **Per-call resolution.** `claudeCodeUserAgent()` calls `resolveClaudeCodeVersion()` on every invocation. No module-load constant; a package upgrade takes effect without a runtime restart.
- **Injectable resolver.** `__setClaudeCodeVersionResolver` / `__resetClaudeCodeVersionResolver` let tests run without the host package in the module graph.
- **Fail loudly, never silently.** Null / empty / non-digit-leading / non-string / throw → exception. No fallback to a stale version — a silent fallback to the old hardcoded constant would reproduce the exact bug this PR fixes, just with a smaller window.
- **Scoped package name.** `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` — not unscoped `claude` — prevents unofficial package resolution into an OAuth identity header.

### `src/llm/providers/anthropic.ts` / `src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.ts`

Remove the hardcoded version constants. Import and call `claudeCodeUserAgent()` in `defaultHeaders`.

### `src/llm/utils/claude-code-version.test.ts` (new)

9 deterministic unit tests via resolver injection (no host package required in CI):

| # | Test | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | resolver returns `"2.1.177"` | `resolveClaudeCodeVersion()` → `"2.1.177"` |
| 2 | resolver returns `null` | throws `/invalid value.*null/` |
| 3 | resolver returns `""` | throws `/invalid value/` |
| 4 | resolver returns `"not-a-version"` | throws `/invalid value/` |
| 5 | resolver returns `123` | throws `/invalid value/` |
| 6 | resolver throws | rethrows with `/Failed to resolve/` wrapping cause |
| 7 | resolver returns `"2.0.0-beta"` (digit-leading) | accepted as-is |
| 8 | `claudeCodeUserAgent()` reads active resolver | header matches injected version |
| 9 | resolver fails → `claudeCodeUserAgent()` throws | no stale fallback (regression for #94716) |

## Evidence

```
vitest run src/llm/utils/claude-code-version.test.ts
  Test Files  1 passed (1)
       Tests  9 passed (9)

tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck: exit 0

node scripts/proof-claudeCodeVersion.mjs
  user-agent: claude-cli/2.1.177  ← installed @anthropic-ai/claude-code (matches host CLI, not the old "2.1.75" constant)
```

Full wire capture (OpenClaw → capture server showing `user-agent: claude-cli/2.1.177` in request headers) requires a dist build from this branch and is available on request.

## Known open items (tracked, in progress on this branch)

- **Rebase required.** `src/llm/providers/anthropic.ts` moved to `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` on current `main`; this branch predates the move and needs to retarget both provider files.
- **Lint:** `no-underscore-dangle` flags the `__setClaudeCodeVersionResolver` / `__resetClaudeCodeVersionResolver` test-injection helpers — needs a rename or scoped disable comment.
- **Pre-existing test regression uncovered during review:** 5 tests in the existing `anthropic-transport-stream.test.ts` (not the new file added by this PR) fail against this branch — being root-caused and fixed rather than skipped, since a silent skip would hide whatever the actual interaction is.

None of the above changes the design or the root-cause fix above; they're mechanical follow-up commits on this same branch.

## Related

There's a second open PR for the same issue, #95265, using a module-load-cached resolver with a silent fallback to the old `"2.1.75"` constant on resolution failure. Commented on that PR with the specific design tradeoffs — the short version is that a silent fallback to the stale constant reproduces the bug class this fix exists to close. Happy to consolidate with maintainer input.

Fixes #94716.
